assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production distant scenery panorama for a real 3D third-person arcade racing game. This is ONLY a scenic background bitmap, not a screenshot or mockup.
Primary request: an elegant coastal harbor at warm peach dusk, broad calm blue sea, a small distant white lighthouse on a headland, a few tiny sailboats far out across the bay, subtle coastal town silhouettes and layered distant cliffs.
Style/medium: premium painterly 3D environment concept art, polished softly faceted natural forms with rich atmospheric depth, sophisticated believable scenery, crisp silhouettes softened with distance.
Composition/framing: ultra-wide 3:1 panoramic landscape, ideally 3072x1024 or 1536x512. Horizon around the lower third of the frame; the top 60 percent is spacious open sky with a few delicate horizontal cloud wisps. Long-distance view with all landforms kept small and far away, broad details useful across horizontal moving crops. Keep bottom quarter calm water and distant low coast, no close foreground.
Lighting/mood: gentle sunset glow, tranquil cinematic atmosphere.
Color palette: pale peach and apricot near horizon transitioning to dusty lavender and muted blue overhead, slate-blue water, warm amber lighthouse light.
Constraints: no cars, no race track, no foreground roads, no people, no text, no logos, no watermark, no frame, no UI; full-bleed single continuous panorama, no panels.
